map.类型断言 as 能随便用吗？: Can the type assertion `as` be used freely?
map.不建议。as 只是告诉编译器「相信我」，不做任何运行时检查，滥用会把真正的错误掩: Not recommended. `as` merely tells the compiler "trust me" and performs no runtime check; overusing it hides real errors, and the program still crashes at runtime. A safer approach is to use type guards (typeof, in, custom predicate functions) or validate then narrow; only use assertions when you truly know more than the compiler.
